Emily Birnbaum / Bloomberg :

 Senate Banking Committee Chairman Tim Scott says Jensen Huang will testify publicly on December 3, focusing on oversight of US export controls   —  Newly reinstated Nvidia Corp. chief executive officer Jensen Huang will testify publicly before a powerful Senate committee on Dec. 3, according to a statement from the panel's chairman.

prioritas.indok: Jensen Huang szenátusi meghallgatása az chip-exportról fontos iparági esemény, de a témában van jobb tétel. Forrás-tapasztalat: -3.
